intent: Show the user's location in a hierarchy and let them navigate to an ancestor page.
avoid_when: there is only one level of navigation (omit entirely rather than show a single crumb)
a11y_contract: wraps items in `<nav aria-label="Breadcrumb">` (overridable) via React Aria Breadcrumbs. The current page is marked programmatically, and a collapsed "..." menu item ships a default aria-label ("See all breadcrumb items")
responsive_contract: the gap between crumbs narrows below the md breakpoint
requires_data: an ordered list of crumb items with label and href; the last item represents the current page
